release_trap.description: load_audited_replaced_vision defaults release_vision=True. It filters all vision prefixes out of the source state, never loads them, and then sets vision_tower and multi_modal_projector to None. That destroys the exact SigLIP and projector weights a distillation student must inherit.
release_trap.required_usage: For raw-stem distillation call a full strict loader that loads both vision and projector; do not call this method with default arguments. If release is needed later, release only after all inherited weights have been copied and audited.
release_trap.second_trap: The source state's vision tensors are reported in replaced_vision_present but are not loaded into the module. Presence in the checkpoint is not evidence that the constructed policy uses them.
